title: Bijou pit band members and midnight shows for white audiences
summary: He names the Creole trumpeter George Jefferson and pianist Maggie Hargraves, and describes the white midnight rambles at higher prices.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And, who else was in that band?

Well there was George Jefferson, who was a fine trumpet player from New Orleans, he was a Creole trumpet player, very fine -- legitimate trumpet player, I don't think he was a jazz trumpet player at all.
Pianist was Maggie [Hargraves], I think she's from Newark or something like that, she's a very fine pianist, you know playing shows and things like that she was exceptional.

The drummer, I don't know who -- I don't remember who in the heck was playing drums. I think they had one of the students from Mahari playing drums there for a while. I don't know his name. There wasn't too many drummers around in --
Did the Bijou -- that was a black theater --
Did they have these nights for white people --
They had those -- and then the prices went up?
The prices went up, absolutely, yes.
